newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel denies its helicopters attacked in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israel denies its helicopters attacked in Lebanon.

text.p: The Israeli military denied its helicopters rocketed suspected guerrilla targets in southeastern Lebanon on Wednesday.
"There was no attack by Israeli air force helicopters," a military spokeswoman said.

Security sources in Lebanon said Israeli helicopters fired rockets into an area around the villages of Qilya and Mazra'at ad-Dallafi, just outside the eastern sector of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
"They bombarded the area with air-to-surface missiles," one source said. There was no immediate report of casualties.
